posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Thanks! It's almost certainly memory pressure, which is something we've been struggling with throughout the development of the game. Rebooting your device may help, though we don't like to have to recommend that. Another thing you can try is turning off the page flip animation in the options - it uses a bunch of memory to capture the screen and animate it.

We'll continue to work on reducing the memory footprint (and memory spikes) in updates.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Krayden006:

Noticed a small typo.  No big deal really.  Legacy, Ra, Visionary vs. Omnitron in Megalopolis.  Looked at Visionary's trash and the title read "Visionary's tras."

The H is there but it's down on a new line. That's a bug in the GUI system we're using that we're working on resolving. You may see similar artifacts once in a while, e.g. in the middle of the screen popups.
